Class Card

java.lang.Object
model.cards.Card
Direct Known Subclasses:
BuildingCard, TribeCard
public abstract class Card extends Object
Abstract base class representing a generic game card. Acts as the foundational data structure for all polymorphic card hierarchies (e.g., Tribe cards, Building cards) instantiated via the factory layer.

  • Constructor Details

    • Card

      public Card(int id, Era era, int playerCount, String imagePath, String backImagePath)
      Constructs a new base Card with the specified structural and visual properties.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique sequential identifier assigned by the respective factory
      era - the chronological Era (ERA_I, ERA_II, ERA_III) this card belongs to
      playerCount - the minimum number of players required for this card to be included in the game deck
      imagePath - the relative resource path for the card's front graphical asset
      backImagePath - the relative resource path for the card's back graphical asset

    • registerToTribe

      public abstract void registerToTribe(Player player)
      Integrates the card into the specified player's tribe.

      This method is responsible for applying state mutations when the card is acquired. Depending on the concrete subtype, this triggers the specific functional interfaces resolved by the factories during initialization (such as executing a dynamically bound BuildingEffect or adding a specific character to the player's demographic counts).

      Parameters:
      player - the target Player acquiring the card

    • accept

      public abstract void accept(CardVisitor visitor)
      Accepts a generic card visitor to implement double-dispatch polymorphism. Used primarily by the row management system to safely route cards to their specific zone or logic handler without relying on instanceof checks.
      Parameters:
      visitor - the CardVisitor performing an operation on this card
